about: R2-DECK-LAYOUT section D4 (ledger D-95); R3-COMMS-V2 CV4 raised active_stations to 5 (the comms station faces the bow under its screen, and its zoom frames the pole): the bow evaluator's thresholds on the exported bridge (make deck-layout-eval). 'Today' is the grounded-bridge-v2 export (art/deck-layout-v2/baseline.sha256); 'A' is the in-engine measurement of layout A from the plan. R3-COMMS-V2 CV6 (AC8): monitor_readable_min, each ambient monitor's Bow readable share (in frame, facing, >= 40 px at 720p, 2 of 3 rays clear after fades); the signal screen must also read from the spawn, the chair, comms and Voyage, and no monitor may stand on the walk.
